runtime.source_policy: 01-原始素材 is immutable; never rename, move, overwrite, normalize in place, or delete source files.
runtime.scope_policy: The repository root is the local collection folder, but runtime reads only the explicitly selected project plus repository workflow reference files listed in references. Do not scan another video project, an old project, the whole motion library, or unrelated paths. An explicit user-supplied source or preview file may be read only for the current operation.
runtime.output_policy: Write every generated artifact to the matching 02-07 stage directory inside the selected project.
runtime.privacy_policy: Never upload project media, transcripts, credentials, or renders unless the user separately authorizes an exact destination and exact files.

efficiency_tools.authorization_policy: Proxy generation, frame extraction, and process inspection are separate operations. None authorizes editing, Remotion preview rendering, final rendering, process termination, upload, or publication.

short_proxy.manifest: One .proxy.json sidecar per proxy, containing the absolute source path and source in/out range for relinking

render_process_check.scope: Only suspected render processes whose command or working directory matches the exact current project path

scan_and_build_exclusions.git: .gitignore excludes local project roots, old projects, the motion library, source media, proxies, transcript caches, review frames, renders, dependencies, and common build output.
scan_and_build_exclusions.editor: .vscode/settings.json uses VS Code's supported files.watcherExclude and search.exclude settings for heavy local-only paths.
scan_and_build_exclusions.remotion_webpack: Each newly created project's 05-Remotion工程/remotion.config.ts uses Config.overrideWebpackConfig() and Webpack watchOptions.ignored for immutable or generated directories inside that current project.
scan_and_build_exclusions.node: Node.js has no universal watcher exclusion setting. Run commands from the current project's 05-Remotion工程; Node and Remotion bundle only imported modules. Configure a different project-specific watcher only if that project actually introduces one.
scan_and_build_exclusions.unreferenced_motion_library: The shared 动效库 remains outside the current Remotion project and must not be enumerated or imported wholesale. Only an explicitly selected asset or module may be referenced; unreferenced files are outside the bundler dependency graph.

requirements: 为每段口播标记语义落点和画面状态
为每段设计人物构图与转场轨：P0/P1-L/P1-R/P2-*/P3 状态、归一化 x/y/width/height、裁剪比例、手势保留、图层顺序、进入/落定/退出、稳定时长和字幕安全区
人物构图只在语义状态变化处调整；同一口播保持人物视频和音轨连续，通过裁剪、遮罩、缩放、位置和层级变化完成重构
扫描口播稿中的代码、提示词、命令、配置和分步指令；只有存在可复制原文时才使用 code-prompt-stage
代码框逐字使用项目提供的原文，保留缩进、换行、参数和占位符，长内容按语义分页而不是缩成小字
为每次画面状态变化选择与语义匹配的转场
录屏、截图、图片和文档优先全屏展示
素材全屏或标题出现时真人缩到安全角小窗
字幕只放在主画面并避让真人小窗和关键 UI
使用 Shotcraft 卡时校验 card、style-key、镜头卡全文和准确 demo TSX
